rows.note: Use 雕像 for an individual sculpted artwork, especially one representing a person, animal, or figure.

example.english: That sculpture in the museum looks just like a real person.
example.traditional: 博物館入面嗰尊雕像好似真人咁。
example.jyutping: bok3 mat6 gun2 jap6 min6 go2 zyun1 diu1 zoeng6 hou2 ci5 zan1 jan4 gam3

rows.note: Use 雕塑 as the all-purpose term for sculpture as an art form or for a sculpted artwork when the specific object is not being emphasized.

example.english: I really liked studying sculpture when I was young.
example.traditional: 我細個嗰陣好鍾意學雕塑。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 hou2 zung1 ji3 hok6 diu1 sou3
